description: The bar chart illustrates the GLUE performance of various fine-tuning methods applied to RoBERTa-base and RoBERTa-large models, with the x-axis listing the fine-tuning methods—Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S₁-model, S₄-model, and S₅-model—and the y-axis showing the GLUE performance score ranging from approximately 85.5 to 89.0. Each method has two bars representing the performance on RoBERTa-base (blue) and RoBERTa-large (orange), with the legend indicating that the blue bars correspond to the base model and the orange bars to the large model. The chart shows that RoBERTa-large consistently outperforms RoBERTa-base across all methods. Among the methods, LoRA and BitFit achieve the highest performance on both models, with LoRA-large reaching the maximum score of approximately 89.0. The S₁-model and S₄-model show similar performance, with S₄-model slightly higher than S₁-model. The S₅-model also shows high performance, with RoBERTa-large achieving a score of about 88.5. The Prefix and Adaptor methods show lower performance, with Adaptor-large achieving a score of about 88.0 and Prefix-large around 85.8. The chart highlights the effectiveness of different fine-tuning strategies, particularly LoRA and BitFit, in improving the performance of RoBERTa models on the GLUE benchmark.
